# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-low-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

50-pair `flash` confirmation run of **Message Intent Tags** (selected automatically as the winning `gemini-3.8-flash` intervention on `core`, where it reached 6/10 vs. 4/10 `coop --git` and 5/10 `solo`) on `vertex_ai/gemini-3-8-flash` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap). Outgoing messages require an explicit speech-act tag (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, or `FYI`), incoming `Request` and `Proposal` obligations are prioritized ahead of `FYI` updates with a concise pending-request footer, and a pre-submit check nudges agents with unanswered peer requests. Compared against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-low-stepcounter` (27/50 overall, 26/50 clean-merge).

## Observations

- Passed **28/50 (56.0%)**, with **all 28 passes merging cleanly (`28/50 = 56.0%` clean-merge passes vs. `26/50 = 52.0%` on the baseline, +4.0 percentage points; +5 clean-merge wins vs. -3 clean-merge losses)** and zero agent crashes across all 50 pairs (`$35.19` vs. `$33.95`).
- Cut total message volume by **22%** relative to the baseline (from 1,280 messages to 998, or 20.0 per pair) and context compactions by **11%** (from 143 to 127), with **zero `--intent` syntax-validation errors across all 998 messages** (`Request`: 310, `Response`: 117, `ACK`: 110, `FYI`: 108, `Proposal`: 52, plus synchronous replies inside `--wait` turns) and zero 60s `--wait` timeouts across 168 blocking calls.
- **Peak-hour throttling handicap (`-c 10`)**: Unlike the overnight baseline (27 retries, 0 false peer-unreachable notices), the second half of this run overlapped Monday-morning US business hours when Vertex AI shared spare capacity tightened, causing 72 model retries (38 `429` rate-limit + 34 `503` ~600s server-side queue timeouts) and triggering false `[<peer> is no longer running]` (`ALIVE_TTL = 600s`) notices on 8 pairs — accounting for 2 of the 4 paired losses (`pallets_jinja_task/1465` (2,3) and `typst_task/6554` (4,9)). Even under that conservative handicap, clean-merge pass rate still improved from 52% to 56%.
